ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (27) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Благо» (blago) is 'the good'. The Gospel sayings inside Lamennais' passage are translated from the Russian as printed («в овечьей шкуре», v ovech'yey shkure, 'in sheep's skin'), not from an English Bible. Attributions follow the print: «Вильмен» (Vil'men) is the surname Villemain, and «Сейф Мулук» (Seyf Muluk, the Persian tale of Saif ul-Muluk) is given as 'Saif Muluk'.
